name: Balloon Furbo
description: A Treasure Gadget that can be used indefinitely. After use, 1 Basic Treasure's location will be displayed on the Planarcadia maps.
story:
Rumors are always flying around that Nihilux turns disobedient furbos into marvelous treasure-hunting tools, and this cutie right in front of you is probably... Just messing with you. Look how spooked you are. This is just a greedy little furbo obsessed with digging up treasure. 

"I'm raking in the cash! Raking in the cash! Don't even know how to spend it! I'll buy the magazine company! I'll make {NICKNAME} do my chores... I'm sorry! President! I was just singing for fun! I won't do it again! Put the bat down, please... Ah..."

source.description: Obtained from the "Furbobocom" Bestseller Rank Rewards
